findings.comment: The Texas 811 'Call Before You Dig' utility notification logo appears on both Sheet 3 (General Notes) and Sheet 9 (Site Plan). Per ZLU-4.33, this logo should appear once only on the most appropriate primary reference sheet. Remove the logo from one of these sheets to comply.

Sheets 23-27 contain construction details for Austin Water utility infrastructure (water, wastewater, fire service). The requirement under UCM 2.5.1.E.20 states that Austin Water standard detail drawings must appear on dedicated AW detail sheets and not be mixed with details from other departments. Available documentation does not provide sufficient detail to confirm whether these sheets contain only AW utility standards or if they mix AW standards with non-AW department standards (e.g., DPD or other city departments). Visual inspection of the actual sheets is required to verify compliance.
